name: Fourth Sister's double-bladed spinning lightsaber
description: The double-bladed spinning lightsaber was wielded by the Inquisitor known as the Fourth Sister. It was similar in appearance to the double-bladed spinning lightsabers wielded by other Imperial Inquisitors. She utilized the lightsaber during her mission to capture Jedi Master Obi-Wan Kenobi, on Daiyu. The lightsaber was abandoned in a cave.
